description: Main application component for a notes app, handling note listing, editing, creation, deletion, and interaction with backend API.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main React functional component managing notes state and UI interactions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches notes from API and updates state, managing loading and error states.

methods.name: showToast
methods.description: Displays toast notifications with given message details.

methods.name: handleSelect
methods.description: Handles selection of a note from the list.

methods.name: handleCreateNew
methods.description: Prepares the app state for creating a new note.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves a note, either by updating an existing one or creating a new one.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes a note after user confirmation.
